items.title: Catenarity and universal catenarity can be checked at the localisations at primes or at maximal ideals
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file algebra.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma states that catenarity and, for Noetherian rings, universal catenarity can be tested after localising at all primes or merely at all maximal ideals (statement lines 25751-25767). The proof does not reprove the theory of dimension chains: it uses catenarity of localisations for one direction, reduces the other to the correspondence between chains of primes and chains after localising at a maximal ideal, and treats universal catenarity by pushing the property along a finite type ring map and invoking the first case (proof lines 25769-25789). The correspondence of chains is what makes the maximal-ideal test sufficient. H2.
